title: Temperature records of the world
intro: Match each verified air temperature record with the place where it was observed.

questions.prompt: Where was this record observed: World highest air temperature record?
questions.explain: 56.7 C was observed at Furnace Creek (Death Valley), California on 1913-07-10; the WMO news release gives it as the World highest air temperature record.

questions.prompt: Where was this record observed: Continental Europe highest air temperature record?
questions.explain: 48.8 C was observed at Syracuse, Sicily on 2021-08-11; the WMO news release gives it as the Continental Europe highest air temperature record.

questions.prompt: Where was this record observed: World lowest air temperature record?
choices: Automatic weather station on the Greenland ice sheet
questions.explain: -89.2 C was observed at Vostok station, Antarctica on 1983-07-21; the WMO news release gives it as the World lowest air temperature record.

questions.prompt: Where was this record observed: Eastern Hemisphere highest air temperature record?
questions.explain: 55 C was observed at Kebili on 1931-07; the WMO news release gives it as the Eastern Hemisphere highest air temperature record.

questions.prompt: Where was this record observed: Antarctic continent highest air temperature record?
choices: Automatic weather station on the Greenland ice sheet
questions.explain: 18.3 C was observed at Esperanza station on 2020-02-06; the WMO news release gives it as the Antarctic continent highest air temperature record.

questions.prompt: Where was this record observed: Northern Hemisphere lowest air temperature record?
choices: Automatic weather station on the Greenland ice sheet
questions.explain: -69.6 C was observed at Automatic weather station on the Greenland ice sheet on 1991-12-22; the WMO news release gives it as the Northern Hemisphere lowest air temperature record.
